name: NICE_Clinical_Guidelines_Search
description: Search NICE (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence) clinical guidelines and evidence-based recommendations. Provides access to official NICE guidelines covering diagnosis, treatment, and care pathways for various medical conditions.

query.description: Medical condition, treatment, or clinical topic to search for in NICE guidelines (e.g., 'diabetes', 'hypertension', 'cancer screening')

limit.description: Maximum number of clinical guidelines to return (default: 10)

oneOf.description: Search results plus the upstream match count, so a page of rows is distinguishable from the whole corpus.

total.description: Documents matching the query upstream. Null when the backend publishes no match count (a curated topic page rather than a search index).

retrieved.description: Rows fetched from upstream, before this tool filtered them.

returned.description: Rows in `data`. Fewer than `retrieved` means this tool dropped rows, not that upstream had fewer.

name: WHO_Guidelines_Search
description: Search WHO (World Health Organization) official clinical guidelines and health recommendations. Provides access to authoritative global health guidelines published by WHO. Searches WHO's curated health-topic pages when the query names a WHO health topic, falling back to the query's first significant word (so 'malaria vaccine' can be answered by the whole malaria topic page), and otherwise searches the WHO IRIS institutional repository for the query term. Each result reports which answered it in 'matched_via', including the topic slug actually used, so a broadened match is visible. Both backends return WHO publications generally, not guidelines only, so 'is_guideline' is set only where the record's title or document type says so -- expect many results with 'is_guideline': false, including on topics where WHO does publish guidance under another name (handbooks, toolkits, operational manuals). A term WHO has no documents for returns an empty list.

query.description: Medical condition, disease, or health topic to search for in WHO guidelines (e.g., 'malaria', 'HIV', 'diabetes', 'tuberculosis')

limit.description: Maximum number of guidelines to return (default: 10)

oneOf.description: Search results plus the upstream match count, so a page of rows is distinguishable from the whole corpus.

data.description: List of WHO documents matching the query.

is_guideline.description: True only where the record's title or document type identifies it as a guideline. WHO publishes guidance under other names (handbooks, toolkits, operational manuals), which this does not detect.

document_type.description: IRIS document type (e.g. 'Publications', 'Technical Documents', 'Journal articles'). Null for health-topic page results, which carry no type.

matched_via.description: Which backend answered: 'health_topic:<slug>' (the slug shows any broadening) or 'iris_search'.

total.description: Documents matching the query upstream. Null when the backend publishes no match count (a curated topic page rather than a search index).

retrieved.description: Rows fetched from upstream, before this tool filtered them.

returned.description: Rows in `data`. Fewer than `retrieved` means this tool dropped rows, not that upstream had fewer.

name: NICE_Guideline_Full_Text
description: Fetch complete full text content from a NICE clinical guideline page. Takes a NICE guideline URL and extracts all sections, recommendations, and complete guideline text. Use this after finding a guideline with NICE_Clinical_Guidelines_Search to get the full content.

url.description: Full URL of the NICE guideline page (e.g., 'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng28'). Must be a valid NICE guideline URL.

oneOf.description: Complete NICE guideline content with full text, sections, and recommendations

metadata.description: Guideline metadata including publication date and guideline code

full_text.description: Complete guideline text with all sections and content

full_text_length.description: Length of full text in characters

recommendations.description: List of specific clinical recommendations (up to 20)

name: WHO_Guideline_Full_Text

url.description: Full URL of the WHO publication page (e.g., 'https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240113879'). Must be a valid WHO publication URL.

oneOf.description: WHO guideline content including overview, main content, and PDF download link

url.description: URL of the WHO publication page

metadata.description: Publication metadata including date and ISBN

overview.description: Overview and description of the guideline

main_content.description: Main content text extracted from the web page

pdf_download_url.description: Direct URL to download the full guideline PDF (if available)

has_pdf.description: Whether a PDF download is available

limit.description: Maximum number of guidelines to return (default: 10)

title.description: Full title of the SIGN guideline

url.description: Full URL to the guideline on sign.ac.uk

error.description: Error message if the request failed

url.description: Full URL to the guideline on sign.ac.uk

error.description: Error message if the request failed
